adverse_interpretation_challenge.tempting_claim: One purchase, a7-hour Last Received value and a Healthy label prove this genuine order and its consent are correctly tracked.
adverse_interpretation_challenge.rebuttal: The selected date scopes totals; Last Received can have a different window and lacks exact timestamp/UET timezone proof. Parameter names carry no values or identity. Healthy explicitly reflects no EEA/UK/Swiss sample. The event can be unrelated, duplicated upstream or emitted by a different publisher path sharing the UET tag.
adverse_interpretation_challenge.decision: Accept only root-observed Custom purchase event receipt. Keep exact order, source path, value/currency/items, goal-level conversion acceptance, sender deduplication, consent and paid attribution separate.

limitations: Root-native observations, repeated counts, action receipts and saved settings were audited for internal consistency, not independently replayed live.
The UET timezone is not separately exposed; the campaign footer must not be treated as a fixed offset or exact UET timestamp. Relative Last Received is not bound to the selected date.
No downloaded export exists, and the described export schema does not promise raw values or exact identity.
The purchase publisher/source stream and conversion-goal-level acceptance were not established by the event summary.
No denial/grant/revocation behavior or regional purchase sample was verified. The September12 consent finding remains separately dated evidence.
No global task/automation inventory or fresh campaign enumeration was performed; the packet reports preservation and this review creates no task/automation.
The support addendum remains unsent; its correctness review is not authorization to contact support or change tracking/paid settings.
optional_clarity_improvement: If the concise READBACK or support addendum is sent alone, carry forward the JSON qualification that Last Received may be outside the selected-date totals and UET has no separately exposed timezone/exact timestamp. The current linked packet is not contradictory.
next_action: Continue the existing supported publisher/support path on the already-pending answer or supported source change; seek supported exact purchase payload/identity evidence without repeating the unchanged export/test paths or creating a duplicate task.
